comment: E4 Round 27 — federation frontier conflict resolution. Spec authority: federation/move-anchor-replication.md + authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md (lattice join). Two federation peers each issue a concurrent Move on the same cell. Pulling the peer's Anchor must resolve the conflict via lattice join — not last-write-wins, not duplicate apply. CasRegister conflicts go to Bottom; OrSet additions union; Counter PN sums.

lattice_join_table.cas_register: concurrent updates on different values → Bottom (Conflict diagnostic)
lattice_join_table.or_set: concurrent adds union; concurrent (add, remove) — remove if causally precedes add, otherwise add wins
lattice_join_table.counter_pn: concurrent increments sum; final value = sum of all PN deltas
lattice_join_table.fsm: concurrent transitions go to lub of states; if no lub exists → Bottom

vectors.name: concurrent_cas_register_move_resolves_to_bottom
vectors.comment: Peer_a writes display_name="Alice", peer_b writes display_name="Alicia" to the same cas-register cell concurrently. After both peers see each other's anchor, the register joins to Bottom and the cell is flagged as conflicted; clients display the conflict-resolution UI.

expected.rationale: Concurrent cas_register on same cell with different values joins to Bottom per lattice spec.

vectors.name: concurrent_or_set_adds_union
vectors.comment: Peer_a adds tag="red", peer_b adds tag="blue" to the same or-set cell concurrently. After Anchor pull, the or-set holds both tags — union is commutative.

expected.rationale: OR-set adds commute; concurrent inserts both land.

vectors.name: concurrent_counter_pn_increments_sum
vectors.comment: Peer_a +5, peer_b +3 on the same PN counter cell. After Anchor pull, the counter joins to +8 (sum).

expected.rationale: Counter PN sums all increments under join.

vectors.name: anchor_pull_idempotent_after_conflict_resolution
vectors.comment: After the conflict resolves to Bottom, peer_a pulls peer_b's Anchor a second time. Result is identical — re-applying the same anchor is a no-op (idempotent).

expected.rationale: Anchor pull after conflict resolution is idempotent — second pull does not flip Bottom back to a single value.
